title: Greenhouse integration for interview scheduling
description: Keep Greenhouse as your system of record while Cadence schedules interviews: candidate sync in, stage write-back out, encrypted API-key connection.

faq.q: How does the Greenhouse connection authenticate?
faq.a: A workspace admin adds a Greenhouse Harvest API key with the minimum permissions for candidate reads and stage updates. The key is encrypted at rest and can be rotated or removed at any time.

faq.q: What does Cadence write back to Greenhouse?
faq.a: Scheduling outcomes: as interviews are booked and candidates progress, updates flow to the linked Greenhouse candidate through a retrying outbox, so Greenhouse stays the source of truth without re-keying.
